evidence: The atomic force microscopy (AFM) of the films was measured by Seiko SPI3800-SPA-400 scanning probe microscope. The capacitance-voltage (C-V) measurements were carried out using a Keithley 590 C-V analyzer. The bonding structures of the films were examined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). The thickness of native SiO2 layer on Si substrates was determined by ellipsometry.
